names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 aprilie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Irineu, Episcop de Sirmium».

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 26 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свештеномученик Иринеј епископ сремски.“, with the rank word Свештеномученик left off and with the see епископ сремски left off as well. The heading gives no epithet beyond the see, so the bare forename is what the source gives; no other folder in the corpus holds a Serbian Иринеј.

The title of both of days.pravoslavie.ru's life pages for him, «Священномученик Ириней, епископ Сирмийский», with the rank and the word for bishop left off. The name link behind the day line spells the see «Сармийский» instead, and the day line itself calls it «Сремского»; the form here follows the two life pages.

death.note: saint.gr: beheaded by the governor Probus and his head thrown into the river Savus (288 AD). Wikidata Q240598 and the article “Irenaeus of Sirmium” put it at 304; the two prints disagree and both are kept.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Иринея, еп. Сремского (304)»

attestations.note: The row this folder's life already described and nobody had written. The calendar's day line calls his see «Сремского», Srem, and the name link behind the forename spells it «Сармийский», while both of the life pages the index serves are titled «епископ Сирмийский»; the form stored here follows the two life pages and the misspelling is recorded. Both life pages head him «Дни памяти: 26 марта , 30 августа (Серб.)». The second day is not repeated by any day page read for this folder and is not thirteen days from this one, so it is a note and not a feast — and it agrees with neither of the two August days already on this folder, the Greek 23 August nor the Serbian 26 March old style: the Russian calendar's idea of the Serbian day is a third reading and is the author's to settle. The index serves two lives, life6918 and life711; the longer, life711, is the same reading azbyka.ru gave this folder in September and adds nothing to it. The day page's three hymns are all the Archangel Gabriel's.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 aprilie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Irineu, Episcop de Sirmium»
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 23 Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Ειρηναίος επίσκοπος Σιρμίου»
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 08.04.2026 (26. март ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Иринеј епископ сремски.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry, and plainly this bishop: the heading gives the see itself, епископ сремски, the bishop of Srem, which is Sirmium and is the see this folder already carries; the entry sets his passion under Maximian, has the prince Probus throw him from a bridge into the river Sava, and dates it 304 — a year inside the «288 or 304» this folder already holds, so nothing was narrowed and no date was touched. Three churches now keep him on three days and none of them is moved by this row: doxologia on 6 April, saint.gr on 23 August, the Prologue on the Julian 26 March. The entry supposes he was a Slav and that before his episcopate he was married and had children, and it has his kinsfolk standing round him under torture begging him to spare himself and them; all of that is new to the folder and none of it is a year. Two men who suffered at the same time are named in it and take nothing: a gardener of Srem called Serenus, and an Afer at Regium. Neither was read as any folder in this corpus — the corpus holds no Serenus at all — and the entry gives neither a day of his own. The stored form is the bare forename, because Свештеномученик is a rank this folder's `types` already carry and епископ сремски is the see it keeps in `office`. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
